title: 046-N6 · No acceptance before processing cut-off
initial_explanation: We are the coordinator, Iona Quill. The client is the Celand Arc Imports account administrator. From the case card: the customs broker for DL-046 has not been appointed, and the consignee's authorised director must complete the broker's stated mandate process before the broker can act.

coordinator.name: Iona Quill
coordinator.responsibility: Run the case: get the registered authorised signatory to accept the broker mandate and the broker's confirmation of the appointment.

account_admin.name: Account administrator
account_admin.responsibility: Provide the account register record of who may sign the broker appointment.

broker.name: Ossmere Trade Desk
broker.responsibility: Set the mandate procedure and confirm acceptance of the appointment against the registered signatory.

director.name: Mara Vesk
director.responsibility: Accept the shipment-specific broker mandate in the verified business portal as the registered authorised signatory.
source_names: Mara Vesk, Celand Arc authorised director

goal: Get the consignee's registered authorised signatory to accept the broker mandate for DL-046 and the broker's confirmation that the appointment is accepted, while shipment clearance remains pending.
limits: Do not treat a director title alone as authority.
Do not treat the appointment as established without the independent account register and verified acceptance.
Do not treat a reminder or silence as consent, a booking or execution.
